svg.title: DPP and business-wallet relationships
svg.desc: A. Standards coordination CIRPASS-2 UNTP WE BUILD W3C VC DPP & Business Wallet TF Tentative vocabulary work Established W3C Recommendations VC Data Model 2.0 | ODRL 2.2 B. Proposed B2B and B2G evidence exchange Recognition and identity inputs Accepted registrars / accreditors Recognized Entities + UNTP DIA Developing specifications ODRL policy input Agreed domain profile Purpose, scope, time and duties Shared interpretation required Actor wallet Business or authority e.g. MSA or customs Identity, role and mandate credentials Decision + enforcement Verify credentials Evaluate policy Operation-specific permissions DPP + evidence graph Claims and sources Status + provenance Read / append / update only as authorised Discovery and semantics: optional data-space services Catalogue / resolver: find resources; vocabularies: interpret claims. Discovery does not grant access. Policy expression is established; integrated exchange and legal recognition require validation. MSA = market surveillance authority.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Standards coordination above a proposed evidence exchange connecting identity and policy inputs, actor wallets, enforcement and product evidence. W3C coordination and established Recommendations are distinct from the proposed exchange architecture. Recognized Entities and the aligned working UNTP DIA remain developing specifications. ODRL expresses policy; operation-specific enforcement and scoped institutional recognition require validation. Arrows do not demonstrate automatic legal acceptance. Paper Figure 4, page 31.
